labels: every number is measured, derived or projected; see *_label fields

GSM4006843.wall_label: measured (/usr/bin/time); depends on node and co-tenancy, see node
GSM4006843.core_s_label: measured (user+sys of the process tree; cgroup counter agrees within 0.5%)
GSM4006843.nonhost_index_load_core_s_label: measured (cgroup CPU between the 'Loading screening indices' and 'Loading host Bloom filter' log lines, 2 s resolution)
GSM4006843.credited_label: derived: core_s minus measured non-host index load (as if a persistent per-node service loaded the three indices once)
GSM4006843.stage_windows_label: measured; wall and core-s between marker lines (2 s resolution): STAR map+solo (incl. fq pass 1, references), sort, index+CB refresh+pileup, non-host index load, non-host classify+EM+writes (+BAM unlink), export incl. demux
